instruction.text: Evie, Arthur and their dads have not been on holiday for 2 years and 5 months. How long is this in months?
Before they can go, they need to renew their passports which takes around 10 weeks. How long is this in days?
Evie looks at the calendar and works out that they are going in 1 week and 3 days. How many days is that?
On the day of the flight, they have to get up at 4:30 in the morning. What time should the children go to bed so that they get 9 and a half hours of sleep? Use the 24-hour clock.
instruction.sound: On the day of the flight, they have to get up at four 30 in the morning. What time should the children go to bed so that they get 9 and a half hours of sleep? Use the 24-hour clock.

instruction.text: The flight takes 3 hours and 17 minutes. How long is this in minutes?
When they land they have to wait 12 minutes for their bags at baggage claim. How long is this in seconds?

text.text: They all leave the airport and have a lovely week in the sun.
